verdict.rationale: Muse is itself a personal AI agent. Users delegate tasks through chat on mobile, Mac or WhatsApp. It then tracks them in a Goals tab, works on a schedule and in response to events, builds its own tools, and asks for approval before actions like sending email or making purchases. App-store reviews and an HN commenter offer light user-side corroboration that delegation works in practice. A stress test that pushed the control plane into timeouts under load does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: rigorous independent hands-on verification of end-to-end task completion and reliability.
